decisions.reason: The accepted LCSC part C94598 is specifically the passive buzzer proposed in message 475; it does not alter the LED board's independently selected LED part C5149201.
Accepting a passive-buzzer part does not change the addressable LEDs' supply voltage, power switching, or data-level handling.
The buzzer part selection contains no GPIO assignment or reassignment.
The accepted buzzer component does not entail any change to the main-board connector inventory, count, or specifications.
The buzzer part acceptance does not modify the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
Selecting LCSC C94598 for the buzzer does not change any panel control, touch input, switch, reset, or button behavior.
The passive-buzzer part selection has no necessary effect on power-source OR-ing or its diode requirements.
The source decision does not change the monitored rails, monitor IC, channel allocation, or current-monitor placement.
Accepting the buzzer part does not entail a change to the switched 3.3V rail topology or transistor pair.
The buzzer component selection does not resolve or alter the standalone USB power source, capacity, or debugging coverage.
The accepted buzzer part is unrelated to I2C series-resistor values, placement, purpose, or population policy.
The passive-buzzer selection does not change the battery-charge status indicator, CHGLED connector, or associated resistor and population settings.
